info.title: santi
info.description: Agile tracker API. Authenticate with the `__Host-santi_session` cookie or `Authorization: Bearer santi_…`. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.

200.description: Signed in; sets the session cookie

201.description: Signed up and signed in; sets the session cookie

200.description: What accepting the invite grants
Joined; the invite is used up
Current versions of the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, and whether sign-up must accept them (D45)

204.description: Account deleted and signed out everywhere. Projects only the caller used are deleted; where the caller was the last admin, the member with the oldest account becomes admin; issues and comments in shared projects stay under "Deleted user" (D45)

429.description: Too many password attempts for this account (D44); wait `Retry-After` seconds

200.description: The account, its token names and every project the caller administers, in full (D45)

schema.description: The lists of the home ("For you").

200.description: Newest first across the caller's projects; `cursor` is an offset
`accepted` is false until the caller accepts the current versions
Accepted; recorded in the append-only acceptance log unless the current versions were already accepted or are not required

429.description: Rate limited per account (D44); wait `Retry-After` seconds

200.description: The caller's projects: recently visited or worked first, then starred, then by key

204.description: Starred; starring again keeps the first time

404.description: No such project or issue among the caller's projects

204.description: Not starred any more (also when it was not)

404.description: No such project or issue among the caller's projects

AccountExport.description:
Everything santi holds about the caller (D45): the account, its API tokens (names only),
every project the caller administers, in full, and the home's stars and history.

legal_acceptances.description: Every acceptance of the Terms of Use, the Privacy Policy and the age declaration.

other_projects.description: Projects the caller is a plain member of: named here, owned by their admins.

oneOf.description: Null for the no-sprint section, which is always last.

cards.description: The cards that pass the quick filters, in rank order.

issue_count.description: Every card in the column, quick filters ignored (D7, KB-15).

oneOf.description: The active sprint on a scrum board (SB-11); always null on kanban.

Card.description: One issue as the board draws it.

parent_key.description: Shown as a chip on subtasks and children of epics (D6).

reporter_id.description: Shows Delete to the reporter as well as admins (D40).

oneOf.description: Also create a status with the column's name and this category (SB-5).

sprint_id.description: Plan the issue into this sprint; subtasks always take their parent's sprint (D6).

status_id.description: Defaults to the project's first mapped to-do status (D5).

name.description: Defaults to `Sprint N`, N counting every sprint ever created on the board (D12).

CreatedToken.description: Returned once at creation; only the hash is stored (D23).

DeleteAccount.description: Deleting the account asks for the password again.

HomeExport.description: D45: what the home keeps about the caller, with the times.

issues.description: Issues the caller starred, opened or worked on.

projects.description: Projects the caller starred or opened.

HomeIssue.description: One row of a home list, from any project the caller belongs to.

at.description: When the row entered the list: last view, last write, star, or last change (assigned).

ImportMapping.description: The confirmed mapping; names are as they appear in the file.

people.description: Person → member user id; unlisted or null = nobody (reporter: the importing admin).

sprints.description: Sprint name → action; unlisted = skip. Sprints with the same name on the board are reused.

statuses.description: Status name → santi status id. Rows with an unlisted status fail.

types.description: Issue type name → santi type; unlisted = the suggested type.

ImportPreview.description: What the file holds, before anything is written.

columns.description: santi field → the file columns read for it.

problems.description: The first 100 problems: failed rows and fields that were dropped or changed.

skipped.description: Already imported from this source (same original key).

ImportSource.description: Where a CSV export came from, told apart by its header row (D41).

file.description: The CSV export, at most 10 MB.

Invite.description: The token is shown once; the invite link is `/invites/{token}`.

InvitePreview.description: What an invite link offers, shown before accepting it.

updated_at.description: Last change a viewer can see: a field edit, a move, sprint planning, a comment or a child.

worked_at.description: Last create, edit, move or comment.

LegalAcceptance.description: One row of the append-only acceptance record: `document` is `terms`, `privacy` or `age`.

text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the page the person was shown, when the server had it.

LegalDocuments.description: The instance's legal documents (D45). `required: false` when the operator turned them off.

LegalStatus.description: Whether the caller accepted the current versions; the app asks again when they change.

after.description: Place right after this issue key (D4). Send at most one of `after` and `before`.

before.description: Place right before this issue key.

sprint_id.description: Absent keeps the sprint; `null` sends the issue (and its subtasks) to the backlog.

status_id.description: New status; absent keeps the current one.

MyProject.description: A project on the caller's home: recently visited or worked first, then starred, then by key.

lead_name.description: The project's oldest admin account, if it has one.

open_assigned.description: Issues assigned to the caller that are not done.

OpenIssuesDestination.description: Where every unfinished issue goes when the sprint closes (D13).

Page_Comment.description: One keyset page (D29): pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; null means last page.

Page_HomeIssue.description: One keyset page (D29): pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; null means last page.

items.description: One row of a home list, from any project the caller belongs to.

at.description: When the row entered the list: last view, last write, star, or last change (assigned).

Page_Issue.description: One keyset page (D29): pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; null means last page.

updated_at.description: Last change a viewer can see: a field edit, a move, sprint planning, a comment or a child.

member_id.description: The project member with this email, if any.

file.description: The CSV export, at most 10 MB.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, the body of every error response (D24).

Project.description: A project as seen by the caller: `role` is the caller's role in it.

archived_by.description: Display name of who archived it.

purge_at.description: When a trashed project is deleted for good: 60 days after `trashed_at` (OR-58).

trashed_by.description: Display name of who moved it to the trash.

ProjectState.description: SAN-70: an archived project is read-only; a trashed one answers 404 until restored or purged.

accept_terms.description:
Must be true when the instance requires its legal documents (D45): the person agrees to
the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

confirm_age.description: Must be true alongside `accept_terms`: the person declares being 18 or older.

line.description: Line in the file where the row starts; the header is line 1.

overdue.description: Active and past its end date; it stays active until completed (D15).

SprintAction.description: What a sprint name in the file becomes.

closed.description: An issue moved on from it, or its cycle ended.

Star.description: A project key (`WEB`) or an issue key (`WEB-12`).

end_date.description: Defaults to two weeks after the start (D12).

column_id.description: None = unmapped: issues in this status are hidden from board and backlog (D30).

category.description: From the file's status category column, or guessed from the name.

suggested_status_id.description: Same name in this project, else its first status of the same category.

done_window_days.description: 7, 14, 30, or null for never (kanban only, D8).

UpdateIssue.description: Absent fields stay as they are; `null` clears a nullable field.

sprint_id.description: Plans the issue (and its subtasks) into a sprint; `null` sends it to the backlog. Scrum only.

column_id.description: The column to map to; null unmaps the status.
